title: A Cellar for the Well
author: Lena Kavanagh
blurb: Ines Okonkwo, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
